parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_contacts (contact_id text PRIMARY KEY, channel text NOT NULL, external_sender_id text NOT NULL, company_id text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(channel, external_sender_id));CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_opportunities (opportunity_id text PRIMARY KEY, contact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES copiloto_contacts(contact_id), stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', intent text, lead_temperature text, product_interest text, need text, motivation text, objections jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, buying_signals jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, missing_information jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, next_action text, action_type text, confidence numeric, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_event_occurred_at timestamptz);CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_events (event_id text PRIMARY KEY, channel text NOT NULL, external_message_id text NOT NULL, sender_id text, contact_id text, opportunity_id text, event_type text NOT NULL, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), text text, UNIQUE(channel, external_message_id));CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_message_results (event_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES copiloto_events(event_id), opportunity_id text, action_type text, auto_respond boolean, delivery_status text, provider_message_id text, handoff_required boolean, processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_copiloto_events_contact_time ON copiloto_events(contact_id, occurred_at);CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_copiloto_opportunities_contact ON copiloto_opportunities(contact_id, updated_at DESC);

WITH input AS (SELECT {{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.channel;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }}::text channel,{{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.external_message_id;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }}::text external_message_id,{{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.sender_id;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }}::text sender_id,{{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.text;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }}::text text,COALESCE({{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.occurred_at;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }},now()::text)::timestamptz occurred_at,{{ (()=>{const v=$json.event_input.company_id;return v==null?'NULL':"'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }}::text company_id),ins AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_events(event_id,channel,external_message_id,sender_id,event_type,occurred_at,text) SELECT 'evt-'||channel||'-'||external_message_id,channel,external_message_id,sender_id,'message_received',occurred_at,text FROM input ON CONFLICT(channel,external_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING *),dup AS (SELECT e.* FROM copiloto_events e JOIN input i ON e.channel=i.channel AND e.external_message_id=i.external_message_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins)),c AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_contacts(contact_id,channel,external_sender_id,company_id) SELECT 'contact-'||channel||'-'||regexp_replace(COALESCE(sender_id,external_message_id),'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]','','g'),channel,COALESCE(sender_id,external_message_id),company_id FROM input ON CONFLICT(channel,external_sender_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now(),company_id=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.company_id,copiloto_contacts.company_id) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) RETURNING *),c2 AS (SELECT * FROM c UNION ALL SELECT cc.* FROM copiloto_contacts cc JOIN dup d ON cc.contact_id=d.contact_id),lock_opp AS (SELECT o.* FROM copiloto_opportunities o JOIN c2 ON o.contact_id=c2.contact_id WHERE o.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE),newopp AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_opportunities(opportunity_id,contact_id,stage) SELECT 'opp-'||c2.contact_id||'-'||substr(md5(random()::text),1,10),c2.contact_id,'new' FROM c2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lock_opp) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) RETURNING *),chosen AS (SELECT * FROM lock_opp UNION ALL SELECT * FROM newopp),upd AS (UPDATE copiloto_events e SET contact_id=c2.contact_id,opportunity_id=chosen.opportunity_id FROM c2,chosen,input WHERE e.event_id='evt-'||input.channel||'-'||input.external_message_id RETURNING e.*) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dup) THEN 'duplicate' ELSE 'continue' END route,COALESCE((SELECT event_id FROM dup),(SELECT event_id FROM ins)) event_id,COALESCE((SELECT contact_id FROM dup),(SELECT contact_id FROM upd),(SELECT contact_id FROM chosen)) contact_id,COALESCE((SELECT opportunity_id FROM dup),(SELECT opportunity_id FROM upd),(SELECT opportunity_id FROM chosen)) opportunity_id,(SELECT channel FROM input) channel,(SELECT sender_id FROM input) sender_id,(SELECT text FROM input) text,(SELECT occurred_at FROM input) occurred_at,(SELECT stage FROM chosen LIMIT 1) previous_stage;

parameters.query: SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.contact_id,o.stage,o.intent,o.lead_temperature,o.product_interest,o.need,o.motivation,o.objections,o.buying_signals,o.missing_information,o.next_action,o.action_type,o.confidence,e.event_id,e.channel,e.external_message_id,e.sender_id,e.text,e.occurred_at FROM copiloto_opportunities o LEFT JOIN copiloto_events e ON e.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id WHERE o.opportunity_id={{ (()=>{const v=$json.opportunity_id;return "'"+String(v).replaceAll("'","''")+"'";})() }} ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const resolver=$('DB — Registrar evento y resolver contexto').first().json;const route=resolver.route;const history=rows.filter(x=>x.event_id).map(x=>({channel:x.channel,sender_id:x.sender_id,text:x.text,occurred_at:x.occurred_at,event_id:x.event_id}));const latest=history[history.length-1];const r=rows[0]||resolver;return[{json:{route,analysis_input:{channel:latest?.channel||resolver.channel||null,sender_id:latest?.sender_id||resolver.sender_id||null,text:latest?.text||resolver.text||null,external_message_id:latest?.event_id||resolver.event_id||null,contact_id:resolver.contact_id,opportunity_id:resolver.opportunity_id,previous_stage:r.stage||resolver.previous_stage||'new',occurred_at:latest?.occurred_at||resolver.occurred_at||null,conversation_history:history}}}];
